sentence: Close the door, please.
noteZhTw: door 指房間或建築物的門。

sentence: The outside wall needs paint.
noteZhTw: outside 作形容詞表示位於外部的。

sentence: The bag is behind the chair.
noteZhTw: behind 表示在某物的後方。

sentence: The country faces economic problems.
translationZhTw: 這個國家面臨經濟問題。
noteZhTw: economic 表示與經濟有關的。

sentence: This is the site of the school.
noteZhTw: site 指建築物或活動所在的位置。

sentence: The bus will approach the station.
noteZhTw: approach 作動詞表示接近某個地方或人。

sentence: Our teacher explained the new lesson.
translationZhTw: 我們的老師解釋了新課程。
noteZhTw: teacher 指教導學生的人。

sentence: The house stands on flat land.
translationZhTw: 那棟房子蓋在平坦的土地上。
noteZhTw: land 指地面或土地。

sentence: The store will charge a fee.
translationZhTw: 這間店將收取一筆費用。
noteZhTw: charge 作動詞表示要求支付費用。

sentence: We finally found the right room.
translationZhTw: 我們最後找到了正確的房間。
noteZhTw: finally 表示經過等待或延遲後終於發生。

sentence: The sign is above the door.
noteZhTw: sign 指用來傳達資訊的標誌。

sentence: They claim the plan will work.
translationZhTw: 他們聲稱這個計畫會成功。
noteZhTw: claim 作動詞表示宣稱某事為真。

sentence: Trust builds a strong relationship.
translationZhTw: 信任能建立穩固的關係。
noteZhTw: relationship 指人與人之間的關係。

sentence: We travel by train in summer.
noteZhTw: travel 作動詞表示從一地移動到另一地。

sentence: I enjoy music after work.
noteZhTw: enjoy 表示喜愛並從某事得到樂趣。

sentence: The family learned about his death.
translationZhTw: 這家人得知了他的死訊。
noteZhTw: death 指生命結束這件事。

sentence: Use a small amount of water.
noteZhTw: amount 指無法逐一計數的事物之數量。

sentence: Practice can improve your English.
translationZhTw: 練習可以提升你的英文。
noteZhTw: improve 表示使某事變得更好。

sentence: This picture shows our family.
translationZhTw: 這張照片展示我們的家人。
noteZhTw: picture 指照片或圖畫。

sentence: The boy is reading a book.
noteZhTw: boy 指男孩或年輕男性。

sentence: She regarded the painting carefully.
noteZhTw: regard 作動詞可表示仔細注視；此句使用過去式 regarded。

sentence: The organization helps local families.
translationZhTw: 這個組織幫助當地家庭。
noteZhTw: organization 指為特定目的組成的團體。

sentence: I feel happy today.
noteZhTw: happy 表示快樂或滿意的。

sentence: A young couple bought this house.
translationZhTw: 一對年輕夫妻買了這間房子。
noteZhTw: couple 指兩個人組成的一對，常指伴侶。

sentence: Please act quickly in an emergency.
translationZhTw: 遇到緊急情況請迅速行動。
noteZhTw: act 作動詞表示採取行動。

sentence: The price is within our range.
translationZhTw: 這個價格在我們的範圍內。
noteZhTw: range 指事物可能涵蓋的範圍。

sentence: The store checks product quality.
noteZhTw: quality 指事物好壞的程度或特性。

sentence: Our class started a new project.
translationZhTw: 我們班開始一項新專題。
noteZhTw: project 指為特定目的規劃的工作。

sentence: The table is round.
noteZhTw: round 作形容詞表示圓形的。

sentence: This job gives me an opportunity.
translationZhTw: 這份工作給我一個機會。
noteZhTw: opportunity 指做某事的好機會。

sentence: The road leads to the station.
noteZhTw: road 指供車輛或人行走的道路。

sentence: His actions accord with his words.
translationZhTw: 他的行動與他的話一致。
noteZhTw: accord 作動詞表示相符或一致。

sentence: Write your name on the list.
translationZhTw: 把你的名字寫在名單上。
noteZhTw: list 指依序列出的項目。

sentence: I wish you a happy birthday.
noteZhTw: wish 作動詞表示希望某人擁有某事。

sentence: It was raining; therefore, we stayed home.
translationZhTw: 當時正在下雨，因此我們待在家裡。
noteZhTw: therefore 表示前面的原因導致後面的結果。

sentence: I wear a jacket in winter.
noteZhTw: wear 表示把衣物穿戴在身上。

sentence: The school received a fund for books.
translationZhTw: 學校收到一筆買書的基金。
noteZhTw: fund 指為特定用途保留的資金。

sentence: The rest of the food is in the fridge.
noteZhTw: rest 指剩下的部分。

sentence: The kid is playing outside.
noteZhTw: kid 是 child 的口語說法，指小孩。

sentence: The city has a growing technology industry.
translationZhTw: 這座城市有不斷成長的科技產業。
noteZhTw: industry 指某一類的產業或工業。

sentence: Good education opens many doors.
translationZhTw: 良好的教育能帶來許多機會。
noteZhTw: education 指學習和教學的過程。

sentence: We measure the table before buying it.
translationZhTw: 我們買桌子前先量尺寸。
noteZhTw: measure 作動詞表示測量大小或數量。

sentence: The heat can kill germs.
noteZhTw: kill 表示使生物死亡。

sentence: This restaurant serves breakfast.
noteZhTw: serve 表示提供食物或服務；第三人稱使用 serves。

sentence: It is likely to rain today.
noteZhTw: likely 表示很可能發生的。

sentence: She will certainly come tomorrow.
noteZhTw: certainly 表示確實或一定。

sentence: The team won a national competition.
translationZhTw: 這支隊伍贏得全國性比賽。
noteZhTw: national 表示與整個國家有關的。

sentence: The door opened by itself.
noteZhTw: itself 表示無生命事物自己，常用來強調。

sentence: She teaches English at school.
noteZhTw: teach 表示教導；此句第三人稱使用 teaches。

sentence: Children ran across the field.
noteZhTw: field 指開闊的土地或特定活動的領域。
